# 919. Complete Binary Tree Inserter

## Solution 1

```python
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right
class CBTInserter(object):

    def __init__(self, root):
        """
        :type root: TreeNode
        """
        self.idx = 0
        self.node_list = []
        q = deque([root])
        p = 0
        while q:
            cur_node = q.popleft()
            self.node_list.append(cur_node)
            if cur_node.left:
                q.append(cur_node.left)
            if cur_node.right:
                q.append(cur_node.right)

    def insert(self, val):
        """
        :type val: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        while self.node_list[self.idx].left and self.node_list[self.idx].right:
            self.idx += 1
        new_node = TreeNode(val)
        if self.node_list[self.idx].left is None:
            self.node_list[self.idx].left = new_node
        else:
            self.node_list[self.idx].right = new_node
        self.node_list.append(new_node)
        return self.node_list[self.idx].val

    def get_root(self):
        """
        :rtype: TreeNode
        """
        return self.node_list[0]


# Your CBTInserter object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = CBTInserter(root)
# param_1 = obj.insert(val)
# param_2 = obj.get_root()
```
